# Entertainment Weekly

> > Entertainment Weekly is a leading entertainment news and pop culture publication covering movies, TV shows, celebrity news, streaming content, and awards coverage including the Oscars and Golden Globes.

EW delivers breaking entertainment news, in-depth features, exclusive interviews, and critical analysis across film, television, streaming platforms like Netflix and HBO Max, and celebrity culture. The publication is known for its comprehensive awards season coverage and entertainment industry reporting.

## Key Topics

- Netflix original series
- Academy Awards (Oscars)
- Golden Globes
- Michael B. Jordan
- Celebrity news and interviews
- Streaming content (Netflix, HBO Max)
- RuPaul's Drag Race
- Reality TV (Love Is Blind)
- Horror films and genre cinema
- TV show reunions and reboots
- Celebrity relationships and divorces
- Ryan Coogler films
- Awards season coverage
- Entertainment industry exclusives
